title: Knsight: Self-Evolving Agentic System for Production Cloud Root Cause Analysis
reason: 图像画布是诊断智能体的核心交互界面：Reviewer 根据画布决定细化、放大或停止，并将反馈转化为推理时复用的技能。相比纯文本基线，端到端结果支持整体设计，但未单独验证视觉循环或技能库的贡献。
abstract: Cloud incident response increasingly relies on LLM agents that translate heterogeneous telemetry and natural-language alerts into operator-facing diagnoses. However, in production RCA workflows, LLM agents commonly serialize these structured signals into text, losing the temporal and topological structure that is critical for diagnosis. We present Knsight, an industry-deployed RCA agent that converts operational telemetry into chart-image canvases and uses a frozen multimodal LLM to reason directly over visual evidence. Knsight introduces Vision Recursive-of-Thought (V-RoT), an iterative diagnose-review-refine loop in which a Reviewer module inspects each canvas and decides whether to refine, zoom in, or stop. To adapt across recurring production failures, Knsight further converts Reviewer feedback into a shared, alias-substituted skill library used at inference time. Offline, on the OpenRCA benchmark, Knsight improves aggregate Correct by 7.0 points over the strongest text-only baseline and reduces timeouts from 117 to 11. Online, in a 90-day deployment across 1,284 production incidents, Knsight increases top-1 acceptance from 38.9% to 71.4% and reduces time-to-acknowledge and time-to-resolve by 59% and 32%, respectively.
